read: list-email-thread-filings {} returns {filings} for the authenticated partner. The app shows only subject and sender_name, never summary, addresses or ids as text. Only current_deal_id supplies the current deal link. Null means currently unfiled; missing or invalid means current destination unavailable. Historical deal and receipt membership never establish a current destination. An omitted receipt removes its destination link without proving whether an uncertain Undo succeeded. activity_version remains the server Undo guard, including null for legacy events.

read_fields.event_id: Filing event UUID, supplied to undo
read_fields.current_deal_id: UUID | null. Current source activity deal_id read in the same SELECT as its filing event. Null means currently unfiled. Independent of historical deal and event order or timestamps; does not establish Undo eligibility.
read_fields.subject: Source email subject, null when unavailable
read_fields.sender_name: Source email sender display name, null when unavailable
read_fields.activity_version: Activity version recorded at filing, null for legacy events

undo: undo-email-thread-filing {event_id,idempotency_key} with a fresh UUID key for a new request. Uncertain outcomes retain the original request and key for replay. Refusals trigger a current-state readback; an unavailable read leaves the outcome uncertain.
deployment_order: The app must not merge before the producer PR is deployed.
membership: Automatic filing receipts only. Explicitly undone receipts and never-filed emails remain omitted. Manual unfiling can leave a historical receipt with current_deal_id null.
